"""Capture future R07-B actual commands and byte bindings; never runs on import."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

OWNED = (
    'src/reprollm/core/pyscan.py',
    'src/reprollm/core/manifest_scaffold.py',
    'src/reprollm/cli/scan_diagnostics.py',
    'src/reprollm/cli/audit.py',
    'src/reprollm/cli/init.py',
    'src/reprollm/cli/export.py',
    'tests/unit/cli/test_scan_diagnostics.py',
    'scripts/gen_quickstart.py',
    'docs/cli.md',
    'docs/quickstart.md',
    'docs/faq.md',
    'docs/export.md',
    'docs/plan/01_specification.md',
    'CHANGELOG.md',
)


def hashes(root: Path) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    return {
        name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if (root / name).is_file() else None
        for name in OWNED
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--label', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--git-shim', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('argv', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not re.fullmatch('[a-z0-9-]+', args.label):
        raise ValueError('safe command label required')
    argv = args.argv[1:] if args.argv[:1] == ['--'] else args.argv
    if not argv:
        raise ValueError('command argv required')
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ledger_file = args.output / 'commands.json'
    ledger = json.loads(ledger_file.read_text()) if ledger_file.exists() else {
        'schema_version': 1, 'task': 'R07-B', 'commands': []
    }
    if any(entry['label'] == args.label for entry in ledger['commands']):
        raise ValueError('command label already retained')
    env = os.environ.copy()
    if args.git_shim is not None:
        env['PATH'] = str(args.git_shim) + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
    before = hashes(args.repo)
    started = time.monotonic()
    completed = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=args.repo, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                               stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
    log_name = args.label + '.log'
    (args.output / log_name).write_bytes(completed.stdout)
    entry = {
        'label': args.label, 'argv': argv, 'cwd': 'REPOSITORY',
        'exit_code': completed.returncode, 'elapsed_seconds': round(elapsed, 6),
        'complete_combined_log': log_name,
        'log_sha256': hashlib.sha256(completed.stdout).hexdigest(),
        'source_test_before_sha256': before,
        'source_test_after_sha256': hashes(args.repo),
        'git_compatibility_shim_used': args.git_shim is not None,
    }
    ledger['commands'].append(entry)
    ledger_file.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    print(completed.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'), end='')
    print(json.dumps({'label': args.label, 'exit_code': completed.returncode,
                      'elapsed_seconds': entry['elapsed_seconds'],
                      'log_sha256': entry['log_sha256']}))
    raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
